name.t: Christmas bauble with sleigh and Father Christmas (name)

summary.t: Sleigh and Santa Claus Christmas bauble in white lacquered MDF with a personalised laser-engraved message.

text.t: Christmas ornament with a personalised silhouette of Santa Claus, a sleigh and reindeer in white lacquered MDF, featuring a small pendant with a laser-engraved message and family name engraving. With a delicate natural twine cord, it is perfect for decorating your Christmas tree and making this season even more special.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: This is an ornament and not a toy: hang it out of reach of small children, who may put it in their mouths.
